Hi everyone — quick technical note ahead of the demo:

Thanks for sharing the forecast template, Mike — once we have the monthly tokens and an estimate of peak concurrency I can finalize a more precise Dedicated sizing. A few items that materially affect recommendations:

- Model family and max seq length (e.g., Llama-2-70B vs Llama-2-13B; longer seq increases GPU memory needs)
- Typical request size (tokens in / tokens out) and response latency target (SLO)
- Whether you need KV/prefix caching (improves cost for repeated prompts)
- Required region and data residency (affects available device types)

Pre-demo checklist I can cover:
- Recommended GPU count and estimated sustained RPS for the pool
- Autoscale/burst settings and cost delta vs hosted
- Example throughput numbers from similar customers (anonymized)
- Any POC steps we recommend (short-term trial Dedicated vs hosted)

If you can paste a couple of sample prompt/response sizes into the forecast file that will help; otherwise we'll work from ballpark numbers.

-Nikhil
